capabilities: Drag whole blocks, children included, to a chosen depth
Select and move multiple blocks by dragging across them
Insert content through a slash menu with custom command rows
Fold blocks to their first line from the hover handle
Optionally give child bullets their own depth markers
extras: Custom insert-menu rows run their command on a single click without confirmation, so binding a destructive command allows one-click deletion; the README recommends disabling the standalone Bullet Depth Markers plugin to avoid conflict. Includes extensive per-version change logs and notes mobile support is coming.
problem: Live Preview edits ragged text ranges, so moving, selecting or folding a block together with its nested children is awkward compared to Notion's whole-block model.

relations.evidence: Built in from the standalone Bullet Depth Markers plugin; disable that one before turning this on.
Notion-like block editing for Obsidian's Live Preview.

summary: Notion-like block editor for Live Preview: drag and select whole blocks, block-aware keys, block folding, and a customizable slash insert menu.
